scripts.//test: Auto-discovery (no path arg). Do NOT pass 'test/': Node 22+ treats a bare directory arg to --test as a module entry and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Windows; a glob would break Node 20. No path works on both.
scripts.//sync-vendor: Refresh vendor/<module> from each shared module's canonical repo (scripts/vendor-sources.mjs finds it). Change the module in its own repo first, then sync; never edit the vendored copy.
